articles.author: Sarah Davis
articles.title: US only country to oppose UN resolution correcting Africa’s size on world maps - The Hill
articles.description: The U.S. was the only country to not support a United Nations resolution adjusting the appearance of Africa and other regions on world maps.  The body passed the “Correct the Map” initiative by a margin of 164 to one, with six nations abstaining from the vote…
